title: Motorcycle Drive Force
body: A powerful motorcycle can produce an acceleration of $$3.50\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**2}$$ while traveling at $$90.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$. $$At$$ $$that$$ $$speed$$, $$the$$ $$forces$$ $$resisting$$ $$motion$$, $$including$$ $$friction$$ $$and$$ $$air$$ $$resistance$$, $$total$$ $$400.0$$ $$N$$. $$The$$ $$mass$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$motorcycle$$ $$with$$ $$rider$$ $$is$$ $$245\, \text{kg}$$.
